lesson: Native tool surface. Pure tools: json.value echoes its input, json.hash returns {algorithm,digest}, json.assert validates a value against a schema and returns {passed,value,evidenceHash}, text.concat joins an array of strings with a separator and returns {value}, json.mergeShallow merges objects and fails closed on a duplicate key, skills.rank scores supplied skills against a query, judgment.gate compares a score against a threshold, memory.candidate builds a reviewable lesson. Read tools: files.read, artifact.inspect, memory.recall, sources.catalog, capabilities.search, skills.snapshot. Write tools needing approval: files.write, memory.promote. Only registered tools exist; source documentation is not an installed capability.
